1306-5226-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1306-5226-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Crypt enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Mana Crypt, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

2455-2707-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Reito Sentinel by paying {3}, causing you to put Walk the Aeons on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

2586-4186-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat

2099-4694-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2099-4694-4802-7306.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

2478-2866-4247-4986.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

215-1753-3151.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
215-1753-3151.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Elvish Archdruid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Elvish Archdruid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2038-3055-3953-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kozilek's Predator, adding {W}.
When Kozilek's Predator dies, Mazzy's second ability and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Mazzy trigger, exiling Gift of Immortality with the ability to cast it until end of your next turn.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Kozilek's Predator from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kozilek's Predator enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate two creature tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Gift of Immortality from exile by paying {2}{W}, attaching it to Kozilek's Predator.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2440-5434-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-5434-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

2757-3887-7496.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
You control a basic Swamp.
2757-3887-7496.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {B} due to its affinity for creatures, creating a creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping the basic Swamp.
Repeat.

225-539-872-1362.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaled Herbalist as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

2034-3372-6006-7297.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
2034-3372-6006-7297.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

1563-2457-3000-7060.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

3532-5078-5402-6289.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5402-6289.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

1283-1987-4423-6918.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Chromatic Orrery by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Chromatic Orrery.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
1283-1987-4423-6918.notes: Once you have sufficient mana, you can instead use Chromatic Orrery to draw cards.

803-3000-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-3394-3490-6783.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
2034-3394-3490-6783.notablePrerequisites: Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
2034-3394-3490-6783.description:
Activate Junk Golem by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

338-4186-4716.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-4186-4716.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-5617-6553.easyPrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
4050-5617-6553.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

2867-2921-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Robot.
When the Robot dies, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Blossoming Tortoise

539-3388-4385-4552.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {0}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Repeat.

224-2174-2653-4967.notablePrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
224-2174-2653-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Thawing Glaciers.
Repeat.

1684-2178-4050.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
1684-2178-4050.description:
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it to create an Elemental token with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Elemental token, adding {R}.
Rakka Mar triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

479-1173-1561-3365.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least twenty-six cards in library.
You have at least 2 life.
479-1173-1561-3365.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss, drawing at least twelve cards and losing half your life total.
Cast Final Fortune, gaining an extra turn.
Activate Aeromeba by discarding a card to switch Aeromeba's power and toughness until end of turn.
Repeat step 3 until you have exactly thirteen cards in your hand.
Pass to the extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Triskaidekaphile triggers, winning the game.

65-615-717-2628-4606.description:
Activate Sheltered Thicket's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Cartographer.
Cartographer enters the battlefield, returning Sheltered Thicket from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat any number of times.
Resolve all Sheltered Thicket abilities, drawing a card each time.
